cohort: A total of 400 pregnant women scheduled for elective caesarean section at SMS Medical College, Jaipur, excluding those with severe comorbidities, psychiatric/psychological problems, on psychotropic drugs, or carrying a fetus with congenital anomalies.
finding: The study found that 74.25% of women experienced significant anxiety (STAI-S score > 40) before an elective caesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Two hours before the elective caesarean section procedure
